title: StateBridge: Training-free Hidden-state Alignment for Latent Communication in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.13317v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model based multi-agent systems usually communicate in text, i.e., using discrete tokens. However, text introduces a discrete bottleneck. Converting the sender's continuous hidden states into discrete tokens discards information that token identities alone cannot capture. Recent work proposes latent communication as an alternative, where agents transmit hidden representations directly without converting them to text. However, existing latent methods either inject working memory layer by layer across the transformers, or require trained projectors that limit portability. We propose StateBridge, a training-free latent communication approach that aligns the sender's final-layer hidden states to the receiver's input space via a closed-form orthogonal transformation. translated_title: StateBridge：无需训练的大语言模型多智能体系统中潜在通信的隐藏状态对齐方法
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统通常以文本形式（即使用离散标记）进行通信。然而，文本引入了离散瓶颈，将发送方的连续隐藏状态转换为离散标记会丢弃仅靠标记身份无法捕获的信息。近期研究提出了潜在通信作为替代方案，其中智能体直接传输隐藏表示，而不将其转换为文本。然而，现有的潜在方法要么在Transformer各层中逐层注入工作记忆，要么需要训练投影器，这限制了可移植性。我们提出了StateBridge，一种无需训练的潜在通信方法，通过闭式正交变换将发送方的最终层隐藏状态与接收方的输入空间对齐。轻量级范数校准和词汇锚定确保与预训练输入分布的兼容性。对齐后的状态被前置到输入中。
tldr: 本文提出StateBridge，一种无需训练、通过闭式正交变换对齐发送方隐藏状态与接收方输入空间的潜在通信方法，实现高效且可移植的多智能体通信。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes StateBridge, a training-free latent communication method that aligns sender hidden states with receiver input space via closed-form orthogonal transformation, enabling efficient and portable multi-agent communication.
